post.description:
User login endpoint.
Authenticates user by email and password, returns JWT token.

Args:
    credentials (LoginRequest): Email and password.
    db (Session): Database session.

Returns:
    TokenResponse: JWT token and user information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If credentials are invalid or user is inactive.

get.description:
Get current authenticated user information.
Requires valid JWT token in Authorization header.

Args:
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user (from dependency).

Returns:
    UserResponse: User profile information.

post.description:
Create a new user (Admin only).

Args:
    user_data (UserCreate): User creation data.
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user (must be admin).

Returns:
    UserResponse: Created user information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not admin, or email already exists.

get.description:
List all users (Admin only).

Args:
    skip (int): Number of users to skip (pagination).
    limit (int): Maximum number of users to return.
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user (must be admin).

Returns:
    List[UserResponse]: List of users.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not admin.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get

get.description:
Get user by ID.
Users can only view their own profile unless they are admins.

Args:
    user_id (int): ID of user to retrieve.
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user.

Returns:
    UserResponse: User information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user not found or no permission to view.

put.description:
Update user information (Admin only, or self-profile for non-admin fields).

Args:
    user_id (int): ID of user to update.
    user_update (UserUpdate): Fields to update.
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user.

Returns:
    UserResponse: Updated user information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user not found or no permission to update.

delete.description:
Delete a user (Admin only).

Args:
    user_id (int): ID of user to delete.
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Current authenticated user (must be admin).

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user not found or current user is not admin.

post.description:
Manually trigger a complete scraping cycle.

**Admin only operation.**

Scrapes all active monitored sources dynamically using native platform
libraries first, then Apify when configured and native ingestion fails.

The request waits for the current cycle to finish.

Args:
    db (Session): Database session.
    current_user (User): Authenticated administrator.

Returns:
    ScrapingResult: Statistics about the scraping operation.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not admin or scraper is already running.

Example:
    ```
    POST /api/scraper/trigger
    Authorization: Bearer <token>
    
    Response:
    {
        "success": true,
        "total_sources": 3,
        "total_posts_found": 45,
        "new_posts_saved": 38,
        "errors": [],
        "duration_seconds": 23.5,
        "sources_processed": {...}
    }
    ```

get.description:
Get the current status of the scraper.

**Requires authentication.**

Returns information about:
- Whether scraping is currently running
- Last scraping execution time
- Current operational status

Args:
    current_user (User): Authenticated user.

Returns:
    ScraperStatusResponse: Current scraper status.

Example:
    ```
    GET /api/scraper/status
    Authorization: Bearer <token>
    
    Response:
    {
        "status": "idle",
        "message": "Scraper is ready",
        "last_run": "2026-08-21T10:30:00",
        "is_running": false
    }
    ```

Get the results from the last scraping cycle.

**Requires authentication.**

Returns statistics from the most recent scraping operation including:
- Number of posts found
- Number of new posts saved
- Processing time
- Any errors encountered

Args:
    current_user (User): Authenticated user.

Returns:
    ScrapingResult: Statistics from last scraping cycle.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If no scraping has been run yet.

Example:
    ```
    GET /api/scraper/last-result
    Authorization: Bearer <token>
    
    Response:
    {
        "success": true,
        "total_sources": 3,
        "total_posts_found": 45,
        "new_posts_saved": 38,
        ...
    }
    ```

Health check for the scraper service.

**No authentication required.**

Returns:
    Dict with health status.

Example:
    ```
    GET /api/scraper/health
    
    Response:
    {
        "status": "healthy",
        "services": {
            "rss": "operational",
            "reddit": "operational",
            "youtube": "operational",
            "playwright": "operational"
        }
    }
    ```
